name: Kallang / Singapore Sports Hub real geographic map background

projection.name: Web Mercator
projection.formula: x = 402 * (longitude - west) / (east - west); y = 402 * (ln(tan(pi/4 + radians(north)/2)) - ln(tan(pi/4 + radians(latitude)/2))) / radians(east - west)
projection.overlayInstructions: Use the same SVG viewBox 0 0 402 390 without cropping, stretching, or translating. At 804 × 780 raster display the viewBox coordinates scale by 2. Preserve visible attribution at bottom right.

provenance.method: One bounded vector extract rendered directly from actual OSM way and water-multipolygon geometry; no standard OSM raster tiles were downloaded. Self-contained SVG with no external graphics, fonts, scripts or network requests. Geographic labels are placed on named real features.

renderingLimitations: Selected feature classes only; not a complete cartographic product.
Road strokes are stylistic, not actual carriageway widths.
Data reflects the OSM timestamp and is not surveyed or independently verified.
provenance.cartoNotUsedReason: Current CARTO basemap terms require an issued API key. No CARTO services or styling were used.

license.renderingAndStyling: Original rendering and styling dedicated under CC0-1.0; underlying OSM geographic data remains ODbL-1.0.
license.dataAvailability: The OSM extract used to render this SVG is included below as gzip-compressed, base64-encoded Overpass JSON, distributed under ODbL-1.0. Decode with base64.b64decode then gzip.decompress.
